sensor: Thermal: uncooled VOx, 640x512, 17 um pixel pitch, 8-14 um, NETD < 35 mK
features: Anti-corrosion thermal-only network bullet camera (uncooled VOx 640x512 detector, 17 um pixel pitch)
75 mm thermal lens, F1.0, 8.3 x 6.6 field of view
Anti-corrosion coating; high-quality detector with 10-year guarantee
Temperature measurement -20 to 150 C, accuracy Max (+/-8 C, +/-8 %); 21 rules (10 points, 10 areas, 1 line)
Dynamic fire detection, up to 10 fire points
Deep-learning perimeter protection: line crossing, intrusion, region entrance and exit
Audio in/out (3.5 mm mic/line in, line out), 2 alarm in / 2 alarm out, RS-485, single-mode fiber

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80). Single thermal channel.

release_notes: Anti-corrosion thermal-only network bullet camera with a 640x512 uncooled VOx detector (17 um, NETD < 35 mK) and a 75 mm F1.0 lens for long-range perimeter protection and fire prevention, temperature measurement -20 to 150 C. Verified against the official Hikvision datasheet.
